term_months.notes: Product type printed 'פיקדון לשנה'; recorded as 12 months. The product's full name allows a term of a year or more.

source.title: בנק מסד, 'ריביות על פיקדונות' (פרסום לפי הוראה 447; דף https://www.bankmassad.co.il/private/depositsandsavings/interestratesondeposits/ מפנה ל-https://online.bankmassad.co.il/appsng/Resources/PortalNG/deposits-details/#/details/46, הנתונים נטענים מ-https://apps.fibi.co.il/bff-depositmanagement/api/v1/bankmassad/depositDetails/46 ו-/creditBalance/46), 'effectiveDate' 2026-10-25, פריים 4.75%, 'nominal': '1.85%'

rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate printed '1.85%' (adjusted '1.8500%') for the lowest amount tier; fixed, 'לא צמוד', 'אין אפשרות שבירה', exit points 'לא קיימת'. Tiers: 1,000-24,999, 25,000-49,999, 50,000-99,999, 100,000-249,999: 1.85% (common 1.85% except 3.30% from 100,000); 250,000 and up: 1.95%. Sister rows: 'גלבוע קבועה שנה' 1.75% from 10,000 (33 days' notice), 'אדיר'/'כפיר' 1.50% with quarterly exit points. The publication's benefits list includes '.פיקדון איתן-הטבה של 0.1500% לשנה' (a benefit for this product); whether 1.85% includes it is not stated.

source.title: פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש], נוסח רשות המסים, עמ' 204, סעיף 125ג(ג)(1): 15% על ריבית מנכס שאינו צמוד למדד; read through il-finance TXI-03 and TXI-04 (checked 2026-10-25)

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08).
